annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2022/112 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 25 January 2022 amending Regulation (EU) 2017/746 as regards transitional provisions for certain diagnostic medical devices and the deferred application of conditions for in-house devices
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2022/112 amending Regulation (EU) 2017/746 as regards transitional provisions for certain diagnostic medical devices and the deferred application of conditions for in-house devices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Regulation 2022/112 amends the In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation (EU) 2017/746, extending transitional periods for diagnostic medical devices by risk class and deferring in-house device conditions because of COVID-19 pressures on notified bodies. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends validity of Directive 98/79/EC certificates and transitional periods to 2025
Staggered deadlines for first-time notified-body devices by class: D 2025, C 2026, B/A sterile 2027
Sell-off dates extended up to 26 May 2028
Defers in-house device conditions in Article 5(5)
Enters into force on day of publication
